title: The tryst
summary: A short, explicit erotic poem about a secret tryst between an older woman and a younger man. The narrative follows their intense physical encounter in vivid, sensual detail, emphasizing the woman's experience of age and desire. After climaxing together, they share a quiet moment at a coffee shop, where the intimacy lingers. The work is written in a highly stylized, lyrical prose that merges sexual imagery with abstract reflections on time and connection.
